findings: The final v2 supersedes the unexecuted v1 draft without modifying it. Wrong A/B mapping, inventory-only acceptance, contradictory companion flag, source association and runtime-status defects identified in drafts are corrected.

Executed blank-HOLIND LNFL F100 RDFIL1 READ920/925 is the source authority. The reader parses the first 100 columns and hashes complete records; the inherited 160-character descriptor is explicitly stale.

TAPE3 INPUT_BLOCK layout matches explicit source types: VNU REAL8; SP/ALFA/EPP/HWHMS/TMPALF/PSHIFT REAL4; MOL/IFLG INTEGER4. Offsets 0/2000/3000/4000/5000/6000/7000/8000/9000, fixed 9750 words and nlines-controlled 250 slots agree with struct_types and LNFL output framing.
Companion MOL bytes are reinterpreted as REAL4, not classified as species. A=(VNU,ALFA,AMOL,TMPALF), B=(SP,EPP,HWHMS,PSHIFT). GNUsgl Y/G locals round to REAL4 before Y1 promotion into VNU REAL8.

Selected flag1 main grouping collects all adjacent negative-IFLG companions until next nonnegative slot/EOF, including across block boundaries. Exact one-source/one-TAPE3 matching and complete group size1 are checked; source/TAPE3 companion flags must match and remain negative.

Listed main fields are compared using the declared source transformations. Main SP reconstruction preserves default-REAL constants and RADCN2/BETA0 rounding, then the double STRSV/VNU expression and final REAL4 assignment. TMPALF reproduces REAL4 one-minus-TDEP.

200/250 K interpolation preserves RECTLC, slope, then TMPDIF order. SP=(SUI*(1+GI*PAVP2)), SPPI=(SUI*YI)*PAVP0 and SPPSP=SPPI/SP match stock source association; the final contract requires exact binary64 shifted center and zero ULP YI/GI/SPPSP, not the earlier draft tolerance.

Pinned trace status/target constants, TAPE5 P/T row and TAPE6 IBRD0 are checked. IBRD0 excludes the additional broadener-specific center-shift term. Source and nonlarge input hashes are rechecked after scanning; each large stream is hashed during its single pass and checked against its expected identity with before/after stat closure.

Fresh output uses exclusive creation and fsync. External supervisor binds plan/reader/review/self hashes, python -I -S argv and fresh output directory, launches once without retries, and persists actual RC before output inventory. Spawn failures explicitly have no confirmed child/null RC; timeout/interruption uses bounded process-group termination/reaping and records terminal versus pending state. No output postflight is accepted unless actual RC0 without timeout/interruption.

A single redacted report is intentional. It contains hashes/offsets, match booleans and derived or already-traced scalars, not raw line/TAPE3 rows or full coefficient vectors. Runtime result status reflects the predicates.
scope_limits: This is source/control-flow readiness for one saved-data audit, not an actual data-match result or promise that the reader will return RC0.
Main source and companion representation checks do not independently validate original SUI population/temperature correction; SPPI/SPPSP use the authenticated traced SUI.
The reviewed equality/ULP contract is for these positive selected scalars and exact saved zeros, not a generic signed-float ULP-distance validation across the full IEEE domain.
No spectroscopic truth, all-negative explanation, clipping, optical-depth acceptance, WRF flux attribution or UDM physical accuracy follows. All negative-OD physical FAILs remain open.

Reviewer checked source/plan/script bytes and small metadata pins only. The 908 MB AER source and 122 MB TAPE3 were not opened or parsed; their numeric identities and matches remain for the single authorized audit.
